note: Final verify = automated headless check (driver/v2/check_v2.mjs) in Chrome with SOFTWARE rendering (no GPU) on the build machine; FPS numbers are software-GL figures, far below what a real GPU gives, and vary with machine load.

claude.title: Backyard Log Splitter
claude.attempts: 3 build attempts (attempt 2 failed the frame-rate check, attempt 3 fixed it) + 1 docs run
known_issues: Medium/High/Ultra are real-GPU presets (about 0.3-1 FPS in software rendering); switching to High there stalls ~30 s while shaders compile
Low looks soft (renders at 0.34x, impostor trees from 10 m, blob shadows only)
Canned swing clips; some foot sliding; carried axe can clip the leg in walk frames
Trees do not regrow and are not saved; reload restores every tree
Two shop axes share the double-bit model and two share the maul model

codex.title: Backyard — Find the grain
codex.attempts: 2 build attempts (both passed) + 1 docs run + 1 extra polish pass (passed)
known_issues: Face, fingers and full-body animation are still approximate: the new grip and torso corrections add no finger curls, and walking has no terrain IK
Crown fading is conservative, and falling trees are a hinge approximation against static bounds, not rigid branch physics
Tree felling is session-only: no regrowth, no timber carrying, no touch movement
Software rendering speed depends on machine load; no real GPU was tested

deepseek.title: American Split
known_issues: Low is soft (~0.18 DPR in software rendering, 16 of 42 trees shown); High is 1-3 FPS in software rendering
First load is slow (10-13 s on a CPU rasteriser)
Trees return after reload (only a felled tally is saved)
Tree fall is a hinge model, not full rigid body; felled log is not a collider
